# Everything exists

Entry point `cmd/app/main.go`, guide [guide](docs/guide.md), dir `internal/pkg/`.

Silent for the right reason: `package.json`, `github.com/foo/bar`,
`application/json`, `src/*.ts`, `<repo>/docs`, `path/to/file.go`, `owner/repo`
and `net/http.Client`.

```bash
./scripts/run.sh
python scripts/x.py
```
